note: W3C documents CSS as the web language for adding presentation style to documents.
Go project documentation describes compiled execution, concurrency mechanisms and garbage collection.
WHATWG describes HTML as the web markup language originally designed for semantic description.
The Python tutorial explicitly describes dynamic typing, application across many areas and an extensive standard library.
The R project directly identifies R as a language and environment for statistical computing and graphics.
PostgreSQL's official SQL tutorial identifies SQL as the relational query language and covers creating and maintaining tables and accessing stored data.
